meta.title: SOD Raqam — Modern ERP for the GCC & India
meta.description: SOD Raqam is a premium web ERP covering CRM, sales, costing, purchase, inventory, invoicing, accounting, HR and payroll — multi-company, multi-currency, bilingual Arabic/English, with Excel and PDF everywhere.

hero.eyebrow: ERP built for the GCC & India
hero.title: Run your whole business on one modern ERP
hero.subtitle: From lead to ledger — CRM, sales, costing, purchase, inventory, invoicing, accounting, HR and payroll in a single, fast, bilingual platform. Multi-company, multi-currency, and ready for the UAE, Qatar and India.
hero.trust: Double-entry accounting · Average & FIFO costing · Arabic & English with full RTL

features.title: Everything your operation needs, connected end to end
features.subtitle: One document chain from the first enquiry to the posted journal — nothing re-keyed, every number traceable.

crm.title: CRM & Leads
crm.desc: Capture enquiries, assign salespeople, log every follow-up and convert won leads into customers and quotations.

sales.title: Sales & Quotations
sales.desc: Costing sheets, revisioned quotations, sales orders, delivery notes and invoices with live margin.

purchase.title: Purchase
purchase.desc: RFQs, vendor comparison, purchase orders, goods receipts and vendor bills against every PO.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.desc: Item master, multi-warehouse stock, minimum-stock alerts and a full stock ledger with average or FIFO costing.

accounting.title: Accounting
accounting.desc: Real double-entry: chart of accounts, journals, contra, opening balances and the three financial statements.

hr.title: HR & Payroll
hr.desc: Employee records, leave balances and approvals, and payroll runs that post straight to finance.

costing.title: Costing sheet
costing.desc: Base cost, insurance, freight and overheads with gross profit and margin per quotation and salesperson.

multi.title: Multi-company & multi-currency
multi.desc: Scope every record by company, quote and post in any currency with document-level exchange rates.

modules.title: Deep dives by module
modules.subtitle: Real features from the live product — grouped the way your teams actually work.

list.name: CRM & Leads
points: Leads with number, date, source, customer and enquiry detail
Assign one salesperson per lead; Open / Won / Lost status
Append-only communication log of every call and note
Follow-up and bid-closing reminders with a due-today list
Convert an open lead into a customer master and a linked quotation
Customer master: unique code, billing & shipping, contacts, credit terms, currency
Filter by status, salesperson and reminders due

list.name: Sales, Costing & Invoicing
points: Costing sheet per quotation: base cost, insurance, freight, overheads
Live gross profit and margin %, with last-sold price per item
Revisioned quotations (Rev 00, 01, …) typed Firm, Budgetary or Tender
Price history and links to supplier quotes; PDF & Excel export
Sales orders from accepted quotations with customer PO and delivery dates
Partial delivery via delivery notes with EXW / CFR / DDP terms
Proforma and final invoices, customer receipts and statements
Overdue invoice list and per-customer statement of account

list.name: Purchase
list.tagline: RFQ to vendor bill, fully linked
points: Vendor master with approved-vendor flag, terms and currency
RFQs from short sales lines, low stock or typed lines
Record vendor responses and compare offers side by side
Purchase orders from the selected quote, with revisions and PDF
Goods receipts with partial receipt and accept / reject inspection
Vendor bills against the PO and GRNs, with approval and posting

list.name: Inventory & Items
points: Item master per company: stock or service, unit, category, manufacturer ref
On-hand quantity per warehouse with minimum-stock alerts
Full stock ledger: opening, in, out, balance, unit cost and value
Average cost or FIFO valuation, set per company
Stock moves only from posted GRNs and confirmed deliveries
Inventory value report and one-click RFQ for shortfalls

list.name: Accounting
points: Chart of accounts with asset, liability, equity, income, expense types
Balanced journal entries with Draft → Posted and reversals
Contra entries between cash and bank, kept out of P&L
Opening balances paired with opening stock at go-live
Trial balance, profit & loss and balance sheet for any date range
Export every statement to Excel and PDF

list.name: HR & Payroll
list.tagline: People and pay, connected to finance
points: Employee records with pay inputs, allowances, deductions and bank details
Leave types (Annual, Sick, Maternity, Casual, Unpaid) with balances
Leave requests with manager / HR approval and automatic unpaid handling
Payroll runs by company, month and year with overtime and deductions
Posted runs produce a payslip PDF per employee
One balanced journal per run straight into the ledger

items.a: Yes. The entire interface is available in Arabic and English with full right-to-left layout, so Arabic-first teams work naturally.

items.q: Can it handle more than one company?
items.a: Yes. Every record is scoped by company and a company switcher lets you move between the businesses you manage.
Any. You can quote, buy and post in multiple currencies, with an exchange rate captured on each foreign-currency document.
It is real double-entry. Invoices, receipts, vendor bills and payroll all post balanced journals into a chart of accounts, and you get a trial balance, profit & loss and balance sheet.
Average cost or FIFO, chosen per company, with a full stock ledger showing quantity and value for every movement.

items.q: Can I export to Excel and PDF?
items.a: Yes. Lists export to Excel and documents and statements print as branded PDFs.
